# Independent completeness check for deletions using pypdf's text stream rather than table extraction.
import json,re
from pypdf import PdfReader
from openpyxl import load_workbook
report=json.load(open('/root/diff_report.json'))
old_ids=[]
for page in PdfReader('/root/employees_backup.pdf').pages:
    old_ids += re.findall(r'^EMP\d{5}', page.extract_text() or '', re.M)
ws=load_workbook('/root/employees_current.xlsx',read_only=True,data_only=True)['Employees']
new_ids=[row[0] for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=2,values_only=True)]
assert len(old_ids)==len(set(old_ids))==10500
assert len(new_ids)==len(set(new_ids))==10485
assert sorted(set(old_ids)-set(new_ids))==report['deleted_employees']
assert not (set(new_ids)-set(old_ids))
print('independent ID check passed: 10,500 old and 10,485 current records; all 15 reported deletions account for the difference')
